<!-- hermes-sweeper:item=26066 -->
<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=implemented_on_main confidence=high -->
Implemented on main. This automated hermes-sweeper review verified that the requested one-dashboard, per-profile management flow is present.

- `875aa8f162aa40f07b19b2ca229720da70193d41` (`feat(dashboard): unify multi-profile management — one machine dashboard, global profile switcher (#44007)`) introduced the machine-level dashboard and global `?profile=` selector.
- `hermes_constants.py:18-75` provides the context-local `HERMES_HOME` override, checked before the process environment.
- `hermes_cli/web_server.py:3854`, `5094`, `5810`, `5938`, `6001`, `6120`, and `13806` scope Sessions, Config/raw Config, and Keys read/write routes by profile.
- `web/src/components/ProfileSwitcher.tsx:12-80` and `web/src/contexts/ProfileProvider.tsx:12-127` implement the profile picker and URL persistence; `web/src/lib/api.ts:45-90` injects the selected profile into scoped endpoint requests.
- Regression coverage exists in `tests/hermes_cli/test_web_server_profile_unification.py:53-143` and `tests/hermes_cli/test_web_server.py:1160-1227`.

This commit is contained in release tag `v2026.6.19`.
